Mind spell. The targeted unit as well as units adjacent to the target location will randomly attack the nearest units, be they friends or foes. Hypnotize effect is dispelled from target. Spell effect is valid until target makes an attack, otherwise Berserk duration is unlimited.

none.description:
{Frenzy}

Mind Spell. Target troop's attack rating is increased by 100% of the troop's defense rating, and its defense rating is reduced to zero. The spell takes effect immediately and lasts during the closest turn of the target. After that, the spell effect lasts until the beginning of the target next turn.

none.description:
{Dimension Door}

Once per day, you may teleport your hero to a visible, unoccupied location on the adventure map in hero visibility zone. This spends 300 movement points.

basic.description:
{Basic Dimension Door}

Once per day, you may teleport your hero to a visible, unoccupied location on the adventure map in hero visibility zone. This spends 300 movement points.

advanced.description:
{Advanced Dimension Door}

Once per day, you may teleport your hero to a visible, unoccupied location on the adventure map in hero visibility zone. This spends 200 movement points.

expert.description:
{Expert Dimension Door}

Two times per day, you may teleport your hero to a visible, unoccupied location on the adventure map in hero visibility zone. This spends 200 movement points.

none.description:
{Fly}

Allows your army to fly over obstacles and rough terrain with 40% penalty to movement cost. Valid for 1 turn. You must land at the end of the turn.

basic.description:
{Basic Fly}

Allows your army to fly over obstacles and rough terrain with 40% penalty to movement cost. Valid for 1 turn. You must land at the end of the turn.

advanced.description:
{Advanced Fly}

Allows your army to fly over obstacles and rough terrain with 20% penalty to movement cost. Valid for 1 turn. You must land at the end of the turn.

expert.description:
{Expert Fly}

Allows your army to fly over obstacles and rough terrain without any penalty. Valid for 1 turn. You must land at the end of the turn.

none.description:
{Sacrifice}

Permanently destroys a friendly living creature group in order to resurrect another friendly living creature group. Resurrection power is ((Spell Power + sacrificed troop's creature base health + 3) x number of creatures sacrificed) hit points.
